messages:
Anya: Quick Q — card list toolbar density feels off when toasts show up. Should we switch the card toolbar from --space-3 to --space-2 (compact) or keep default? Also noticed overflow menu has no aria-label on keyboard nav.
Sam: I leaned toward compact for dense dashboards. Screenshot: https://figma.com/file/xxx (preview). Compact reduces vertical jump when toasts push content.
Mike: Accessibility nit: overflow button needs aria-label="More actions" and aria-haspopup="menu". Also ensure focus ring isn't lost when a toast appears.
Lara: FYI console currently uses --space-2 for table rows but --space-3 for card headers. Harmonizing would help consistency. I'm ok with compact if we adjust line-height.
Anya: Good point re focus. Could we set toasts to appear above the toolbar (z-index) instead of shifting layout? That'd avoid reflow.
Sam: Agree. We can set .toast { position: fixed; top: var(--toast-offset); } quick CSS:
```
.toast { position: fixed; right: 24px; top: 72px; z-index: 9000; }
```
Ben: Cost/impact: compact toolbar reduces vertical height by ~8px per card, so dashboard shows ~6 more cards per viewport on average — small but measurable for power users.
Mike: Also add keyboard shortcut hint for overflow menu (press Enter/Space to open). Make sure screen reader reads role=button and aria-expanded.
Anya: Copy tweak: change "Open" to "Show details" in card action to be more explicit (helps a11y). Thoughts?
Lara: +1 to "Show details". Also propose token rename: --card-toolbar-gap -> --card-toolbar-space so it's clearer.
Sam: I'll mock both options in figma and push a branch. design-bot uploaded file: https://figma.com/file/xxx/variants
design-bot: Uploaded 3 variants (compact/default/compact+toasts-above)
Ben: timeline? We should include on next console polish sprint. Can we ship copy change independently?
Anya: Yes — plan: (1) copy change + aria-label + small CSS for toasts this week; (2) density token decision next week after figma mock and perf check. I'll create a PR for the copy/aria/CSS.
Mike: I'll review the a11y PR.
Sam: I'll attach screenshots to the PR.
Anya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
